verdict.rationale: Orb is a SaaS billing platform that holds customer usage data, so whether it uses that data for AI model training is a fair privacy-posture question. Nothing in the evidence pack covers AI training, data-use policies, or any opt-out control. Data exports and backfills concern billing data movement and do not address training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
